requirements.text: In the airline domain, an airport has a name of type string.
A flight has a maximum number of passengers which is of type integer
An airplane has a name which is of type string.
a passenger in SimpleAirlineDomain has a name and a gender
A time consists of a year, a day, and a minute.
Each airport has multiple flights that depart from it. Each flight can depart from only one airport
A flight in an  Airpline Domain has a unique time of departure and that timing is specific for that flight.

The model defines two classes, one called 'Flight' and the other called 'Passenger'. The class 'Flight' is connected via a directed association to class 'Passenger' which means that the associated 'Passenger' object is reachable from a 'Flight' object. One end of the association is labeled 'passenger' and also carries the multiplicity constraint '0..*', meaning that a 'Passenger' object can be associated with 0 or more 'Flight' objects.
Each flight has exactly one origin airport.
An airline conducts any number of flights.
Each passenger is assigned to exactly one flight.
